colors.role: raised surface / dark text on white

motion.hero_entrance: background scale 1.09 to 1 over 2.4s power2.out; grid lines scaleY 0 to 1, 1.5s, stagger 0.07; headline words rise from yPercent 115 inside masks, 1.1s power4.out, 0.15s per row; founder avatars scale 0.82 to 1, stagger 0.14
motion.button_hover: label rolls up 2.6em to an identical copy (text-shadow clone), 0.3s cubic-bezier(.785,.135,.15,.86), background fills orange
motion.header: hides on scroll down, slides back in on scroll up (translate -110% to 0, 0.45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))
motion.stats: numbers count 0 to target over 1.8s power2.out when scrolled into view, once
motion.process: sticky list of 7 steps; the active step opens and the image beside it swaps
motion.footer: live clocks for 4 cities, updated every 30s
motion.reduced_motion: every script wrapped in gsap.matchMedia with a reduced branch that shows final state

taste.name: Orange lives in the photos, not the interface
taste.trigger: When choosing how much of the page should carry the brand orange
taste.decision: Chose to keep #DB6600 to 0.1% of the interface (CTAs, section dots, //01 numerals) and let orange-lit product photography carry the color, over orange section fills or gradients
taste.reason: Because a dark page with one rare warm color makes every orange mark read as 'press here' or 'this matters'
evidence: process images are black objects lit orange

taste.name: Every section opens with the same mono label
taste.trigger: When structuring a 30,406px page with 12 sections
taste.decision: Chose a fixed grammar (orange dot + uppercase Martian Mono label in a left gutter, content in a right column) over centered section headings that change per section
taste.reason: Because on a page 33 screens long, a reader needs to know where they are without reading a headline
evidence: '• OUR MISSION', '• SELECTED WORK', '• SERVICES', '• OUR PROCESS', '• FAQS' all 12-14px Martian Mono
Martian Mono used 129 times, BDO Grotesk 914

taste.name: A different move for every section
taste.trigger: When deciding how the page should move
taste.decision: Chose one purpose-built animation per section (masked word rise, count-up, pinned horizontal gallery, sticky process swap, live clocks) over one shared fade-up reveal
taste.reason: Because the motion is the portfolio: a studio selling design shows its craft by how each part behaves
evidence: every script has a prefers-reduced-motion branch

taste.name: The founders sign the page
taste.trigger: When establishing trust for a 2-person studio
taste.decision: Chose named founder faces and bylines at the hero, the mission and the closing CTA over an anonymous 'we' voice
taste.reason: Because buyers of a tiny studio are hiring the people, so the people should appear wherever a decision is asked for
evidence: two 1:1 avatars beside 'Team of 2 studio' in the hero
mission signed 'Stefan Hendrickx, Founder + Brand Dept.'
closing CTA carries the same avatar and byline
